title: Crimea: "Soldiers of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, Dear Ukrainians! 35 years...
title_en: Crimea: "Soldiers of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, Dear Ukrainians! 35 years...

description: "Soldiers of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, Dear Ukrainians! 35 years ago, Ukraine regained its independence. But our struggle for it did not begin in 1991. Before us, there were generations of Ukrainians who fought for their state, went underground, sat in prisons, preserved their language, culture and the right to call themselves Ukrainians when they were punished for it. Today, this struggle fell to us. And we know the price well Independence...
description_en: "Soldiers of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, Dear Ukrainians! 35 years ago, Ukraine regained its independence. But our struggle for it did not begin in 1991. Before us, there were generations of Ukrainians who fought for their state, went underground, sat in prisons, preserved their language, culture and the right to call themselves Ukrainians when they were punished for it. Today, this struggle fell to us. And we know the price well Independence...
description_uk: "Воїни Збройних Сил України, Дорогі українці! 35 років тому Україна відновила свою Незалежність. Але наша боротьба за неї почалася не у 1991 році. До нас були покоління українців, які воювали за свою державу, йшли у підпілля, сиділи у в’язницях, зберігали мову, культуру і право називати себе українцями тоді, коли за це карали. Сьогодні ця боротьба випала нам. І ми добре знаємо ціну Незалежності....
